gloss: to keep an eye on; to watch over attentively

definitions.gloss: to keep an eye out; to watch over a whole area attentively
definitions.explanation: To spread one's attention over several people, places, or details at once so that nothing is missed. Typical of teachers, staff, and anyone responsible for a group, and carries a sense of conscientious care rather than suspicion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{目|め}を{配|くば}る。
examples.english: Keep an eye on your surroundings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{店長|てんちょう}→店長：30461_tenchou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{店内|てんない}→店内：03124_tennai⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配|くば}って→配る：03921_kubaru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The manager keeps an eye on the whole store.

examples.japanese: ⟦{担任|たんにん}→担任：16408_tannin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一人一人|ひとりひとり}→一人一人：03711_hitorihitori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{配|くば}り、⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{見逃|みのが}さない→見逃す：04576_minogasu⟧。
examples.english: The homeroom teacher watches over each student closely and misses no small change.

notes:
USAGE:
The thing watched over takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. Because ⟦{配|くば}る→配る：03921_kubaru⟧ means "to distribute," the phrase implies attention spread across a whole scene, so the object is often a group or an area rather than a single item.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{周囲|しゅうい}→周囲：03206_shuui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{目|め}を{配|くば}る: to keep an eye on one's surroundings
- ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{目|め}を{配|くば}る: to watch out for safety
- ⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧⟦ところ→所：01137_tokoro⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{目|め}を{配|くば}る: to attend to every detail

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{気|き}を{配|くば}る→気を配る：26559_kiwokubaru⟧: to be considerate — attention to others' comfort, not visual watching
- ⟦{目|め}を{光|ひか}らせる→目を光らせる：30637_mewohikaraseru⟧: to keep a sharp watch — suspicious and policing in tone
